Hints: Bracket the root using squares, then compare with the square of the rounding midpoint.
Solution: (6.5)² = 42.25 < 48 < 56.25 = (7.5)². Therefore √48 lies between the rounding midpoints 6.5 and 7.5, and rounds to 7. Requested answer: 7.
